I'm Associate Director, Biostatistics at Pfizer in Chennai, where I lead a team
of statisticians across different therapeutic areas to move the global portfolio
ahead.

Before this: primary statistical reviewer at the FDA's Oncology Center of
Excellence. What holds my attention now are the methods that change what a
development program can learn — real-world evidence, target trial emulation,
external control cohorts. The details are in the [CV](cv.qmd).

Away from work I [build things](singlebell.qmd), travel, photograph, and others.

[Views on this site are my own and do not represent my employer.]{.disclaimer}
